Black Friday is absolutely the best time of the year to upgrade all of your Apple devices, phone included. If it's time to renew your phone plan and you're eyeing Apple's recently released iPhone 18 Pro, then you probably want to check out T-Mobile's Black Friday deal. T-Mobile has kicked off its iPhone 18 Pro "On Us" promotion, which gives you 100%, or $1,200 off the newly released iPhone 18 Pro smartphone when you sign up for a new line on a T-Mobile T-Mix Loaded plan and either port in your number from another carrier or trade in an eligible phone. The discount is applied as bill credits over a 36 month period for a total of $1,200 in credit. Note that there is a one-time $35 connection charge.

Get an iPhone 18 Pro "On Us" at T-Mobile

T-Mobile's New T-Mix Loaded Plan Replaces the Experience Beyond Plan

Launched in late October, T-Mobile's new T-Mix plan replaces the Experience plans from earlier this year. It's a similar plan that gives you unlimited talk, text, and 5G premium data, but this time instead of pre-assigned perks, you're free to choose your own perks. Interested in a particular tier but it offers a free Hulu subscription that you'll never use? Well, now instead of being stuck with it you can, for example, pick another streaming service which you might watch on a more regular basis.

Each T-Mix tier gives you a certain amount of "picks" every month that you can use to select your different perks. The T-Mix Loaded tier, which you'll need to sign up for to get the iPhone discount, costs $95 per month with AutoPay and gives you three picks. There are several picks to choose from, including streaming subscriptions Netflix, Apple TV, Hulu, and Paramount Plus, music subscriptions like Pandora or SiriusXM, and features like T-Satellite.

The T-Mix Loaded plan also gives you 250GB of high-speed mobile hotspot, unlimited text and 30GB of high-speed data in Canada and Mexico and unlimited text and 15GB of high-speed data in over 215 other countries.

The iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max features the new A120 Pro processor

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max upgrades the APU to the new Apple A20 Pro processor built on a new 2-nanometer process technology. Apple claims 40% greater graphics performance over the previous iPhone. Other notable upgrades include a main camera that's now equipped with variable aperture from f/1.48 to f/4.0 and faster 60W charging.
